k: Go north of Littleroot Town to Route 101 and help Prof. Birch. You will get your first Pokémon.
Find Birch's kid on Route 103, north of Oldale Town, then return to the lab in Littleroot for your Pokédex.
Go through Petalburg Woods to Rustboro City and beat Roxanne, the Gym Leader.
A Team Aqua grunt stole the Devon Goods! Chase him east of Rustboro into Rusturf Tunnel and get them back.
Take the Devon Goods back to Devon Corp. in Rustboro. The President has a letter and a delivery for you.
Ask Mr. Briney, in his cottage on Route 104, to sail you to Dewford Town. Deliver the letter to Steven deep in Granite Cave.
Beat Brawly, the Gym Leader of Dewford Town.
Sail on to Slateport City and deliver the Devon Goods to Capt. Stern at the Oceanic Museum.
Go north along Route 110 to Mauville City and beat Wattson, the Gym Leader.
Chase Team Magma: from Route 111 go through the Fiery Path to Fallarbor Town and Meteor Falls, then ride the Route 112 cable car up Mt. Chimney.
Walk down Jagged Pass to Lavaridge Town and beat Flannery, the Gym Leader.
Go home to Petalburg City and beat your father Norman, the Gym Leader.
Surf east from Route 118 and go north up Route 119: Team Aqua has taken over the Weather Institute.
Beat Winona, the Gym Leader of Fortree City. If something invisible blocks the way, Steven's Devon Scope on Route 120 reveals it.
Head east toward Lilycove City. Teams Magma and Aqua are after the orbs on Mt. Pyre (Route 122): climb to the summit.
Take the Magma Emblem from Mt. Pyre to Jagged Pass. It opens Team Magma's hideout: stop Maxie inside.
Raid Team Aqua's Hideout on the coast east of Lilycove City before Archie gets away.
Team Plasma is blocking Mossdeep's Gym. Find them in the icy room of Shoal Cave, north of Mossdeep City, and drive them off.
Beat Tate & Liza, the Gym Leaders of Mossdeep City.
Team Magma is attacking the Mossdeep Space Center! Stop them, then talk to Steven.
Dive on Route 128 to reach the Seafloor Cavern and stop Team Aqua.
Groudon and Kyogre are clashing over Sootopolis City. Help Wallace: wake Rayquaza at the Sky Pillar (Route 131). He gives you HM Waterfall after.
Beat Juan, the Gym Leader of Sootopolis City.
Surf to Ever Grande City, cross Victory Road and beat the Elite Four and the Champion.
Go home to Littleroot Town: Interpol agents Nanu and Anabel are waiting for the new Champion.
In Ever Grande City the guard now lets you through. Follow the passage to Steven's Island, where Interpol waits.
Wally called from Petalburg City. Hurry: someone is trying to steal his Mega Bracelet!
Steven called with an emergency. Go to Devon Corp. in Rustboro City.
Find a meteorite fragment in Granite Cave, near Dewford Town. Zinnia is there too.
Bring the meteorite to Prof. Cozmo at the Mossdeep Space Center.
Team Magma took your Mega Bracelet. Go to Meteor Falls and stop them.
Beat Zinnia in Meteor Falls to get your Mega Bracelet back.
Climb the Sky Pillar (Route 131) and face Rayquaza.
Ride Rayquaza into space to stop the meteor. Something is waiting beyond the sky.
Back on the ground, talk to Wallace in Mossdeep City.
Return to Steven's Island. Anabel reports trouble deep inside Meteor Falls: find Steven there.
Anabel found a new Ultra Wormhole near Pacifidlog Town. Go through it.
Report to Anabel on Steven's Island.
Gladion needs you at the Secret Base on Route 111: defeat the Totem Pokémon.
Nanu found strange islands. Pass the four Tapus' trials with the Island Kahunas.
All four Tapus recognise you. Report to Nanu on Steven's Island.
Talk to the Devon Scout on Steven's Island: he has news about Faba. The Ultra Wormhole Faba used will not let you in before his report.
The Devon Scout tracked Faba to the Ultra Wormhole in the Scorched Slab (Route 120). Follow him, and bring a way past whirlpools.
Report to Anabel on Steven's Island.
Anabel says Steven and the former Champions are waiting in the lobby. Train with them.
Report to Anabel on Steven's Island.
The Devon Scout says the Ultra Wormhole fluctuations follow abnormal weather. Find the drought (Terra Cave) or the downpour (Marine Cave).
Report to Anabel on Steven's Island.
The Devon Scout detected an Ultra Wormhole at the top of Mt. Pyre. Go through it.
Report to Anabel on Steven's Island.
Next fluctuation: the icy room of Shoal Cave, where Team Plasma was. Go through the Ultra Wormhole there.
Report to Anabel on Steven's Island.
Next fluctuation: the Ultra Wormhole on Route 116.
Report to Anabel on Steven's Island.
Faba was seen alone near the Mirage Tower in the Route 111 desert. Go and catch him.
Report to Anabel on Steven's Island.
Find Red. The last Ultra Wormholes are deep in Meteor Falls and Granite Cave.
Report to Anabel on Steven's Island.
Collect all 18 Z-Crystals, then go to Pacifidlog Town. The crystals open the way to Team Rainbow Rocket's castle.
Storm Team Rainbow Rocket's castle and defeat them at the Mountain Top.
Return to Steven's Island: Steven is waiting.
Earn a Silver Symbol at the Battle Frontier - for one, beat Salon Maiden Anabel, the 35th battle of a Battle Tower Singles streak. Then see Scott in his Fronti…
Take the ferry from Lilycove City to Champion Island for the World Championships. Familiar faces are waiting.
Show Waji's boat ticket to the sailor at Lilycove City's harbor and sail to Canalave City in Sinnoh.
Earn the eight Sinnoh Gym Badges. Still to beat:
Take Victory Road to the Sinnoh League and beat the Elite Four and Cynthia.
Collect the 17 Plates hidden in Hoenn and Sinnoh. Waji, at the Spear Pillar on top of Mt. Coronet, gives hints.
Step onto the altar at the Spear Pillar with all 17 Plates. The rift that opens will test everything you have.
Waji senses the rift's energy in Celestic Town. Visit its ruins with Dialga and Palkia both caught to open a way into the Distortion World, or go in from the i…
Enter the Distortion World and face the ruler of the reverse world. Ways in: the new passage at the Spear Pillar or Sendoff Spring, or the islet on Route 129 i…
Keep all 17 Plates in your Bag and return to the Mountain Top above Team Rainbow Rocket's castle. The Plates' true owner is waiting.
Arceus sent you to Hearthome City. Find Cogita in a house on the west side of town, with all 17 Plates in your Bag.
Step through the space-time rift in Cogita's house. It leads to the Hisui region.
Find Cogita in Hisui. Rei (Mingyao) at the Deertrack Heights base camp flies you around: look on Firespit Island.
Visit the clan leaders at the hot spring in the Alabaster Icelands.
Diamond and Pearl point to the foot of Mt. Coronet. Enter the Primeval Cave: whoever is behind the rifts is inside.
Volo is beaten. Return to base camp in Hisui: Rei and Cogita have news.
In Solaceon Town in Sinnoh, a woman has slept in a nightmare since her offerings at the Lost Tower. Hear her husband out.
Bring the Lunar Wing to the sleeping woman in Solaceon Town and wake her.
The oppressive presence in the Lost Tower has lifted. Something pitch-black stirs deep inside: face the phantom of nightmares.
Catch Tornadus, Thundurus and Landorus, then show Cogita on Firespit Island in Hisui. She has one more legend to tell.
Kitty in the three-floor house on Steven's Island wants dried fish. Find the Dried Fish on Prelude Beach in Hisui and bring it to her for a nameless stone.
With Kitty's nameless stone in your Bag, climb toward the Sacred Temple in Hisui's highlands. A dread of unknown origin hangs over the summit.
Cogita waits on Champion Island with more to tell.
